system_overview: This specification is the TLC model-checking configuration module for the Atomic Commitment Protocol with Simple Broadcast (ACP-SB). It extends the base ACP-SB specification to make it ready for verification with the TLC model checker, adding symmetry support for participant permutations and providing an alternative formulation of the irrevocability property that TLC can check more efficiently.
actors_and_components: The same actors as the base ACP-SB specification: a set of participants and a single coordinator that coordinate to commit or abort a distributed transaction. This module adds no new actors but configures the system for model checking.
state_variables: The same state variables as the base ACP-SB specification. No additional state variables are introduced. This module only provides a symmetry set (permutations of the participant set) and an alternative property formulation.
initial_state: Identical to the base ACP-SB specification: all participants start alive, non-faulty, undecided, with nondeterministic yes/no votes, and the coordinator starts alive, non-faulty, undecided, with no requests sent and no votes received.
actions: All actions are inherited from the base ACP-SB specification. No new actions are defined in this module.
safety_properties: This module provides an alternative formulation of the irrevocability property (AC4) that is better handled by TLC: expressed as a next-state relation requiring that if any participant has decided commit in the current state, it remains committed in the next state, and similarly for abort decisions. All other safety properties (AC1, AC2, AC3) are inherited from the base specification.
liveness_properties: Inherited from the base ACP-SB specification. The liveness component of AC3 applies.
model_bounds: The participant set is instantiated as a finite set of model values. For model checking, configurations with 2 to 6 participants have been used. The module defines symmetry over participant permutations to reduce the state space.
additional_assumptions: This module extends the base ACP-SB module and the TLC module for model-checking utilities. Symmetry reduction is available through participant permutations but can be enabled or disabled in the configuration.
